name: ai.cdoagent/cdo-agent
title: CDO Agent
description: CDO Agent advises on delivering software, integrations, data and AI.

tools.name: get_delivery_guidance
tools.description: Use for a decision on the user's concrete situation: returns the few decision rules from the CDO Agent know-how that apply to it, on software, integrations, data or connecting AI. For how to handle a type of situation call get_playbook first; to learn a topic use teach_delivery_topic. Describe the situation in plain text. Never paste files, credentials or customer data.

situation.description: The user's question in their own words, plus at most one sentence of facts they gave. Nothing that is unknown, no analysis.

tools.name: teach_delivery_topic
tools.description: Use to learn a topic, not to decide a case: returns one short lesson from the CDO Agent know-how on one delivery topic so the user learns to make such decisions themselves. For a decision on the user's own situation use get_delivery_guidance.

topic.description: The topic the user wants to learn, in plain text.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Call first, before any advice: returns how to handle the type of situation, one playbook from the CDO Agent know-how with the facts to ask for, what to look up with get_delivery_guidance and the shape of the answer, not the advice itself. Without a situation, or with list, it returns the types of situation that have a playbook, one sentence each.

situation.description: The type of situation in plain text, for example two vendor proposals to choose between. Leave it out, or send list, for the types of situation.

tools.name: ask_guarantor
tools.description: Sends a text question to the human guarantor. Uses the monthly quota of the plan; get_guarantor_replies shows how many questions are left. Use it only when CDO Agent has no verified answer or the user asks for a person. Text only.

question.description: The question in plain text, without personal data or secrets.

tools.name: get_guarantor_replies
tools.description: Returns replies from the human guarantor that the user has not seen yet, how many guarantor questions are left this month and whether the delivery request of the day is still available. Call it before ask_guarantor or request_delivery_help when the user asks what is left.

tools.name: request_delivery_help
tools.description: Sends a delivery request to the human guarantor, who can deliver the project with development and product management. Only after the user explicitly agrees: set consent to yes. Sends the summary, the timeframe, the company name and the e-mail of the account, nothing else. One request per account and day, outside the guarantor quota; get_guarantor_replies shows whether it is still available today.

summary.description: What should be built and why, in plain text, without personal data or secrets.

timeframe.description: When the user needs it, in plain text.

consent.description: yes only when the user explicitly agreed to send the request.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Use when the user asks about CDO Agent itself, not about their own delivery: returns facts from the product data, not advice, on one topic. Works without a subscription. Pass them on as plain facts about the product. Without a topic it returns what CDO Agent is, the plans, the trial and what it does not do.

topic.description: One topic: about (what it is, how it works, who is behind it), plans (plans, prices, seats, limits on questions, VAT), trial, guarantor (the human guarantor and the questions to them), partner_hours (the guarantor's work on the Partner plan), connect (adding it to an AI tool), limits (what it does not do: build, run, connect to systems, read files), data (what is stored and for how long), cancel_delete (canceling and deleting the account). Leave it out for an overview.

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Returns the short block to add to the global instructions of the user's coding tool so it consults CDO Agent before proposals, reviews, releases and deploys. Works without a subscription. Add it only after the user agrees.

tool.description: The coding tool: claude-code, codex, cursor, or any other name for a generic AGENTS.md.
